body: Hm, `skia[harfbuzz]` is not a default feature for `windows & !static`. I think it was also meant to be marked as unsupported on `windows & !static`. Similar to `skia[icu]`.

Hi @dg0yt  - how would one know whether is should or should not be a feature for a specific port with a specific OS and/or triplet?
I am learning and trying to understand is all, so if I come across a similar situation in the future?
Thank you very much for all the help you provide.

You didn't do anything wrong ... What I meant is that it should be encoded in the manifest so that vcpkg can shout "unsupported!".

But for the problem here, it would be much better to understand why `skshaper` fails to properly link icu in x64-windows release, after building successfully for x64-windows debug, so that we can remove the whole restriction. I can only collect x64-windows logs from CI (#36963).
Without skunicode / icu, you don't get harfbuzz.

Fixes #32691: unneeded warnings.
Fixes #36928: windows dynamic linkage for icu et al.

These DLLs are possible now (subject to features):
~~~
skia:x64-windows:/bin/dawn_native.dll
skia:x64-windows:/bin/dawn_platform.dll
skia:x64-windows:/bin/dawn_proc.dll
skia:x64-windows:/bin/skia.dll
skia:x64-windows:/bin/skshaper.dll
skia:x64-windows:/bin/skunicode.dll
~~~
